reasoning.step1:
Document classification:
- Contains clear invoice indicators: header "RECHNUNG", invoice-related fields (Rechnungs-Nr., Rechnungsdatum), totals, line items.
- No exclusion terms (e.g., "Mahnung", "Zahlungserinnerung") prominent.
- Conclusion: classify as invoice → proceed with extraction.

Locate candidate fields in text:
- Invoice.Date: "Rechnungsdatum: 22.01.2024" → exact value "22.01.2024".
- Sender.VatId: "Haribo USt-Id-Nr.: ATU73666623" → exact value "ATU73666623".
- GrandTotal.Amount: locate final totals block. "Summe ... Endbetrag" shows "299,09" as final amount. Also line shows "299,09                          299,09" and header indicates Endbetrag. → extract 299,09.
- Net.Amount: in totals block, "steuerpfl. Betrag 271,90" corresponds to taxable net amount → extract 271,90.
- Vat.Rate: totals block shows "Steuersatz 10,00  %" → extract 10 (drop percent per rules).
- Vat.Amount: totals block shows "Steuer 27,19" → extract 27,19.

Verify formatting and rules:
- No inferred values; all extracted values appear explicitly.
- Preserve decimal places as in input (two decimals). Schema expects numeric types; decimals will be converted to numeric with same precision.
- Vat.Rate must be returned as number without "%" → 10 (from "10,00 %").
- Multiple VAT items? Only one VAT group present (10%). So single entries for Net.Amount and Vat.Amount.

Edge cases considered:
- Currency (EUR) present but schema asks no currency symbol; amounts extracted without currency.
- Commas used as decimal separators in source; will convert to numeric representation preserving two decimals.
- Ensure not to extract line-item-level exchange rates (none present).
